Is AI Porn Safe? Privacy Risks, Personal Data and Prompts


# Is AI Porn Safe?


AI pornography privacy: understand the risks to your prompts, personal data and uploaded images.


It is very easy to create AI pornography content by creating images, characters, and edited visuals, or interacting with AI companions. Some sites require you to create an account whilst others allow you to get started quickly.


However, it is worth considering what happens to the information you type in.


You may upload images, type information about your sexual preferences, write detailed fantasies, sign up with an email address, or discuss personal information in an AI companion. Even though what you type may seem to have occurred in private, the information is being handled digitally.


Whether AI porn is safe for you to use depends on the site, how information is handled, what information you provide, and how secure your account is. Potential privacy issues include prompt saving, saving images, tracking, sharing information, data security breaches, and uncertain removal of information.


Below we’ve listed what information may be collected by AI porn sites, what happens to your prompts, and potential privacy issues. We’ve also listed tips for protecting personal information.


## Is AI Porn Safe to Use?


AI porn may not be unsafe, however it may not be private.


In order to produce desired content from AI tools, personal information may be collected. This may be done for account management, moderation, security, analytics, and improving the service.


Potential privacy issues depend on:


Whether the site has a clear privacy policy and terms.


Whether you must create an account.


Whether images and prompts are saved.


Whether conversations are used to improve AI.


Whether information is shared with third party service providers.


How long personal information is stored.


Whether information is adequately protected.


Whether you can remove information that you have stored on the site.


A service with good privacy measures, user control and reasonable security measures may be safer to use than an unknown site with unclear ownership and policies.


However, even with a trustworthy service, it is impossible to guarantee that there are no risks. Be aware of the information you are sharing.


## What Information is Collected?


Depending on what AI pornography service you use and what its privacy policy states, the following information may be collected.


## 1. Prompts and Conversations


You may type numerous prompts to produce the required content. This may include information about characters, sexual interests, fantasies, preferences, scenarios and personal information.


If you are interacting with an AI companion or erotic chatbot, you may provide very personal information in your conversation. This may include information about relationships, insecurities, wishes, feelings and private thoughts.


Depending on the site, information typed in prompts and conversations may be:


Saved in your history


Used to produce a response


Moderated


Analytics or improvements to the service


Used to train AI (depending on the service’s policy and settings)


Stored for a certain length of time after leaving the site.


Therefore, private conversations with an AI on these sites may not be as private as you think.


## 2. Uploading Images


Some AI pornography sites let you upload images.


Depending on the site’s policies, uploaded images may be temporarily processed, saved in your account, or the resulting images may be saved. Some may also be saved for security and operational reasons.


As images can be very personal, they may reveal:


Your identity


Identities of other people in the image


Where you are in your home


Location


Relationships


Personal or intimate information.


Never upload images of other people for sexual manipulation/creation without permission.


## 3. Account and Device Information


Depending on the site, information may be collected relating to your account and device. This may include:


Email address/username


IP Address


Device/browser information


Login information


Cookies/identifiers


Subscription/payment information


User interaction.


This information can be used to manage accounts, prevent fraud, detect technical issues, and understand use of the service.


However, this information could be used to link data to a real person. Even if you choose a username, your use of the service may not be anonymous.


## 4. Cookies and Tracking


Some sites may use cookies, analytics, advertising or other tracking.


This may be used for remembering your preferences, keeping you logged in, monitoring how well the site is performing, understanding how users interact with the site, and for advertising.


Different sites will perform very different amounts of tracking. To minimise excessive tracking within a site, ensure that cookie settings on your browser and in the site’s privacy settings are set to give you more control, as incognito mode may not be 100% private.


## What Happens to My Prompts?


Think carefully about the personal information, prompts and images you share with AI services.


## Are Prompts Saved?


Depending on the site’s data handling policies, prompts may be saved for users to return to your previous creations, or for a limited period of time to deliver the service, fix issues, prevent misuse, and to comply with legal requirements.


Your prompt may be saved in:


Your conversation history


Previously created content in your account


Within the site’s systems


Backups (depending on data retention)


Moderation or safety data.


Even if you delete a conversation from within your account, it may not be instantly removed from all systems within the site. Some sites may have separate data retention periods for backups, security and legal compliance.


## Can My Prompts Be Used to Train AI?


Some AI may be improved via using user interaction. Or, depending on the service, account type and policies, users may be allowed to opt out of this, or have different settings in place. In some cases, free, paid, personal and business account users may also be treated differently.


There is no one rule which applies to all AI pornography sites.


Before using a service, check the privacy policy to see:


If prompts and generated content are used to improve AI models.


Whether you can opt out.


If files uploaded are used to improve AI models


If conversations may be reviewed by humans.


If third party providers process your data.


[According to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner](https://www.oaic.gov.au/privacy/privacy-guidance-for-organisations-and-government-agencies/guidance-on-privacy-and-the-use-of-commercially-available-ai-products) , caution should be taken with personal/sensitive information in public generative AI tools.


## Can People Read My Conversations?


Depending on the service, authorised staff may be able to view specific user interactions for moderation, security, support or other reasons stated in the policies.


Whilst it is unlikely that every conversation will be regularly viewed by people, information typed into online services may not be just seen by you.


If using a chatbot on AI pornography sites, highly personal conversations should be considered as sensitive. Avoid including unnecessary personal details.


## 7 Privacy Issues with AI Porn


## 1. Sensitive Sexual Information


The information typed in prompts may be very personal. You may include sexual preferences, fantasies, relationship issues, and personal intimate details.


If this information is connected to an account, email address, device ID or other information, it could potentially be traced back to you.


In particular, this information may be very sensitive if it is made public due to unauthorised access, incorrect sharing, or a data breach.


## 2. Data breaches


As AI pornography sites process data, personal information may be vulnerable to security issues.


Depending on the information which is stored, email addresses, account details, messages, uploaded images, or other information may be exposed.


If intimate information or information that could cause embarrassment, harassment or blackmail is exposed, this may be very serious.


## 3. Identity Sharing Even with a Pseudonym


Even if you type in a pseudonym, it may not be fully anonymous.


Technical information, such as IP addresses, cookies, device information, and account information may be processed. If you use the same username, email address, or other identifiable information across different sites, it may be easier to link accounts together.


Privacy issues occur based on combined information, not just your display name.


## 4. Storing or Reusing Personal Images


Uploading your images may create privacy issues.


Depending on the site, images may be stored, visible in your history, processed by other service providers, and/or stored for a certain period of time as outlined in the policy.


If images contain personal information, ensure that you are comfortable with the site handling your images correctly.


## 5. Information Shared with Third Parties


To operate, AI pornography sites may share information with external providers. These may include hosting, analytics, payment, customer support, security, and other services.


The privacy policy may outline what information is shared with these third parties, and in which circumstances.


The privacy policy should state what category of third parties information is being shared with, and for what reason. If it is unclear who is handling your information, or why, be cautious.


## 6. Linked Accounts and Payments


Creating an account with a social media account, using your main email, or paying for a subscription may link your identity with the service.


Payment information may include payment details, subscription status, payment details, or identifiers passed from your payment provider.


Consider what account or payment information you are comfortable sharing. Avoid services asking for unnecessary personal information.


## 7. Unclear Data Removal Policies


Deleting an account may not mean that all information is removed from all systems.


Some information may be held on the site for certain limited reasons. This may include security, legal compliance, preventing fraud, resolving conflicts, and in backups.


Ensure that clear information is provided about removing data. If you can’t find clear information on what happens to information if you remove your account, uploaded images or conversations, then you may be less assured with your privacy.


## Is AI Porn Safe in Incognito Mode?


No. When using incognito/private mode, only certain data may not be saved on your device. This depends on your browser. For example, browsing history and cookies may not be saved once you close the session.


However, information may still be collected by the site. If you have signed in with an account, or information may still be stored on the service. Data may also be stored on the service and/or collected in other ways.


Incognito mode will not make your information safe from:


Information being collected by the site in relation to your session.


Activity being linked to your account.


Data being stored on the service.


Security issues occurring.


Tracking outside of your browsing history.


Information you intentionally provide.


Although incognito mode can make information safe from being stored on your device, it does not make it completely anonymous.


## Tips to Safely Use AI Porn Tools


Although you can not completely avoid privacy issues, we recommend the following to limit the sensitive information you share.


## 1. Use Sites with Clear Privacy Policies


Before creating an account, ensure that there is a clear privacy policy outlining what information is collected, stored, shared, removed and used for training.


Be cautious of sites with no clear owner, unclear terms and conditions, or no useful information about how images and prompts will be handled.


## 2. Avoid Personal Information in Prompts


Try to avoid including your full name, address, workplace, phone number, or other personal information in prompts.


If interacting with an AI companion, try to separate personal information from the fantasy. The AI will usually not need to know your real identity to interact with you.


## 3. Be Careful with Uploads


Avoid uploading personal, intimate, identifiable, or sensitive information to sites you are unsure of.


Never upload images of people without their permission for sexual manipulation.


## 4. Check Privacy Settings


Ensure that the service gives you control over:


Conversation history


Saved content


Shared information


AI training


Targeted advertising


Account visibility


Removing data.


Use these settings to limit unnecessary information collection.


## 5. Ensure Account Security


Use unique passwords for each site. If available, enable two factor authentication.


Do not use the same passwords that you use in your email account, banking services and social media. It is particularly important to use a unique password for your email account as it may be used to reset passwords on other services.


## 6. Avoid Unnecessary Linked Accounts


If given the option to sign in with multiple accounts, consider what information is being shared with the service.


Avoid linking social accounts, contact lists and other services simply for ease of access.


## 7. Delete Old Accounts


If you no longer use a service, consider deleting your account and any unneeded saved information.


However, first check the data deletion policy to determine what information will be removed, and what may be kept for limited purposes.


## Things to Consider Before Using an AI Porn Site


Taking a few minutes to consider the following information can help you make a more informed decision regarding sharing information on a site.


Consider:


Consideration


Why?


Privacy Policy


Know how information is handled.


Are prompts saved?


Know if conversations are saved.


AI Training


Know if interactions may be used to improve AI.

Know how images and created content are stored.

Site Transparency

If any of this information is missing, confusing, or conflicting, consider carefully whether to upload sensitive information.


## Research on AI Porn and Privacy


For further reading, see the[literature review of privacy concerns in conversational chatbots](https://doi.org/10.1002/asi.24898) , which analyzed 38 papers, and the[NSW Information and Privacy Commissioner’s guide to privacy risks associated with generative AI tools](https://www.ipc.nsw.gov.au/resources/guide-privacy-risks-associated-use-generative-ai-tools) .


Research and guidelines from privacy regulators show that sensitive personal information may be included in prompts and interactions on AI pornography sites.


Research in information science published in 2024 looked into 38 studies relating to privacy in chatbot interactions. In these studies, concerns were raised with regards to the information shared, handling, and misuse of data during interactions.


Guidelines from privacy regulators have also highlighted that prompts, uploaded files and generated content may include personal information.[According to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner](https://www.oaic.gov.au/privacy/privacy-guidance-for-organisations-and-government-agencies/guidance-on-privacy-and-the-use-of-commercially-available-ai-products) , caution should be taken with sensitive information in public AI tools.


[Guidance from the NSW Information and Privacy Commissioner](https://www.ipc.nsw.gov.au/resources/guide-privacy-risks-associated-use-generative-ai-tools) also outlines potential issues with unauthorised information sharing, data breaches, prolonged storage, and difficulty removing information from AI systems.


This shows that not all AI porn sites manage user information in the same way. Just because a site has a privacy policy, does not necessarily mean it is thorough, easy to understand, or sufficient to make you feel comfortable.


## What to Do If You Have Already Shared Sensitive Information


If you are worried about your privacy after using an AI porn site, don’t panic. Just because you have shared information with a service, does not mean it will be leaked or misused.


To get things under control, consider:


Review your account to see what personal information, images and conversations are saved.


Delete unecessary content, including images, conversations and uploads if possible.


Review privacy settings to turn off any optional data sharing/training.


If you have used the same password elsewhere, change your password. If available, enable two factor authentication.


Review payments to see if payment information is linked to your account.


If you no longer wish to use the service, follow the official procedure to delete your account.


If you receive threatening or blackmail messages, be careful. Save evidence and do not quickly pay money or reply.


If personal images or sensitive information has been exposed, report it to the site and relevant authorities. If you are feeling very overwhelmed, reach out to a trusted support organisation.


## FAQs


## Is AI porn private?


AI porn may be lower risk to use with a trustworthy service, little information shared, and clear privacy settings. However, no online service can be guaranteed to be completely private and risk free.


## Can AI porn sites see my prompts?


Your prompts will be processed to give you the desired service. Depending on the site’s privacy policy, prompts may also be saved, reviewed, used for moderation, analysed, or used to improve the service. View the site’s policy for more information.


## Do AI porn sites save my conversations?


Depending on the service, conversation history and created content may be saved in your account. Do not assume that conversations will be removed once you close your tab or log out of the site.


## Can AI porn sites use my prompts for training?


Depending on the service, account type and policies, some may use user interactions to improve their AI models/services. However, some may offer opt out options.


## Are free AI porn sites less safe?


Not necessarily. Just because a site is free to use, does not mean it is unsafe. Similarly, just because a site requires payment for access doesn’t mean it is any safer. Instead, look at how transparent the company is, security, and data handling policies and terms of use.


## Is a VPN Safe for Me?


Using a virtual private network (VPN) hides some of your IP address and encrypts data sent to and from your device. However, information can still be collected from you, and monitored within your account. Prompts and images may also be stored.


## Is There a Way to Delete All Information Shared on AI Pornography Sites?


Within the site settings, or by requesting, you may be able to delete your account, chat history, uploaded files and all other data. However, it may take time for all copies of your data to be deleted if they have been kept for valid legal/ security reasons. Check the site’s privacy policy for details on how to delete your information.


## Final Thoughts


AI Pornography is not inherently risky. However, you may be placing unnecessary risks on yourself by not considering privacy.


By providing prompts, uploading pictures, chatting, providing personal account details and device information, more information about you may be given away. Different sites will have differing policies in place regarding user data, how long they store information for, security and deleting information. Information provided within AI systems should never be assumed private simply due to it being a chatbot or being used for personal content.


Be aware of what information you’re sharing, check the site’s privacy policy, secure your account and do not include sensitive personal information.


To keep this as safe as possible, try to provide less information, use trusted services, and maintain control of your digital information.


It’s important to look after your privacy, even if you’re doing something personal online.
